title: Pew Research Center: Information Retrieval Habits in the Generative AI Era
author: Monica Anderson
content:
A survey conducted by Pew Research Center reveals that 32% of US adults have used generative AI chatbots for information retrieval.

Among respondents aged 18 to 29, the adoption rate jumps to 58%, indicating a profound generational shift in search habits.

Furthermore, 41% of daily AI users report that they cross-reference AI-generated summaries with traditional search engine results to verify factual accuracy.
